title: My Messages
encryptedNotice: End-to-end encrypted. Only the people in this conversation can read these.
nobodyYet: Nobody yet. A conversation opens once a message request is accepted.
ageLocked: Messaging is for people aged 16 and over, and this account has not answered that question yet.

requests.heading: Requests
requests.asked: They want to start a conversation.
requests.youAsked: You asked. Nothing is sent until they accept.
requests.youAskedToConnect: You asked to connect. Nothing changes until they accept.

newConversation.title: Start a conversation
newConversation.description: Somebody from a community you share, or anybody whose full handle you know.
newConversation.hint: A whole handle, number included, reaches somebody in none of your communities.
newConversation.empty: Nobody in your communities has messaging turned on yet.
newConversation.noCommunities: Nobody to show. You share no communities with anyone yet.
newConversation.groupHint: Everyone here will be asked before they join.
newConversation.cannotReachEachOther: {{first}} and {{second}} cannot message each other yet. Everyone in a group has to be able to.
newConversation.tooManyPeople: A group holds at most {{count}} people.
newConversation.checkingRoster: Checking that everyone here can message everyone else…
newConversation.checkUnavailable: That check could not be made just now. Try again in a moment.

noHistoryHere: Nothing on this device yet. Messages you had elsewhere stay there.
sendFailed: That message could not be sent.
recipientHasNoDevice: {{name}} has not set up encrypted messages yet, so this could not be delivered.
deviceFailed: Encrypted messages could not be set up on this device.
unsupportedBrowser: Encrypted messages need a secure connection and a browser that can run them. Check the address starts with https (or is localhost), or try the app.

start.waiting: Waiting for them to accept. You can message each other once they do.
start.asksToMessage: They asked to message you. Accept, and the two of you can talk.
start.mayAsk: You haven't messaged them yet. Ask first — they can accept or decline, and nothing is sent until they do.
start.denied: You can't message them right now.

openFailed: That conversation could not be opened.

edit.editing: Editing this message. Escape to stop.

remove.title: Remove this message?
remove.body: It goes from this device, and their client takes it off theirs. A message they already read is a message they already read — this cannot unsay it.

newDevice.title: New device signed in
newDevice.body: {{device}} signed in to your account. If it's yours, verify it: both screens will show the same four pictures to compare.
newDevice.error: Couldn't save your answer. Try again.
newDevice.gone: That device has signed out or was removed, so there's nothing to verify.

historyAsk.title: Verify this device from another of yours
historyAsk.body: Open Messages on a device you already use and choose Verify there. Keep this one open: both will show the same four pictures to compare. Your message history arrives once you do.
historyAsk.dismissNote: Dismissing this only hides it. Your messages still arrive once you verify this device from your other one.

verification.title: Compare with {{device}}
verification.waiting: Waiting for your other device. Keep Messages open on it.
verification.compare: Check that both screens show these pictures, in the same order.
verification.label: Pictures to compare
verification.waitingForOther: Waiting for your other device to confirm.
verification.verified: Verified. This device can now read and send your messages.
verification.mismatch: Not verified, and nothing was changed. If you don't recognize this device, remove it.
verification.cancelled: The verification was stopped on the other device. Nothing was changed.
verification.timeout: The verification took too long and was stopped. Nothing was changed. Try again.
verification.elsewhere: A verification is already running in another tab.
verification.error: Couldn't verify the device. Try again.

invitation.heading: You have been asked to join a group

platformDisabledBody: This deployment does not offer direct messages. Nothing has been deleted — if they are switched back on, your conversations are where you left them.
